description_en: Generates an evaluation report for a specified compliance package within a specified account group
description_zh: 为指定账号组内的指定合规包生成评估报告
kebab_example: aliyun config generate-aggregate-compliance-pack-report --compliance-pack-id cp-fdc8626622af00f90000 --aggregator-id ca-f632626622af00790000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateAggregateCompliancePackReport

parameters.help_en:
The compliance package ID.

For information about how to obtain the compliance package ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The account group ID.

For information about how to obtain the account group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to generate multiple files based on the resource ownership user ID. Valid values:
true: Generates multiple files. This is the default value.
false: Generates a single file
parameters.help_zh:
是否按资源归属用户ID生成多个文件，取值：
true：生成多个文件（默认值）
false：生成单个文件
parameters.name: multi_files
